## Brief (docs/09-page-brief-checklist.md → docs/templates/page-brief.md)

- [ ] Stage 0 — worth doing (no cannibalisation, in plan)
- [ ] Stage 1 — query & intent (variants, PAA, SERP features)
- [ ] Stage 2 — competitors (top-3 matrix, must-have / best-in-class / gaps)
- [ ] Stage 3 — formula from primary source, ≥ 5 reference examples
- [ ] Stage 4 — features & UX (≥ 2 advantages)
- [ ] Stage 5 — content & SEO plan (title, description, H2s, FAQ, links)
- [ ] Stage 6 — external link candidates
- [ ] Stage 7 — decision: **3 advantages over top-3** named

Brief file: `docs/briefs/<slug>.md`

## Build

- [ ] `npm run new <id>` · logic + tests · island · MDX · meta
- [ ] PR opened with the template checklist
- [ ] Merged, Status = Published in the plan
